# RAGbase Shield contractual roles (French). Written for RAGbase Shield, Apache-2.0.
# Defined party roles of contracts ("ci-après le « Concessionnaire »"): a defined term, never a company or a
# person name word. Loaded with the legal terms; a legal form right next to one still makes a company
# ("Concessionnaire SAS") (R1, CL-17).
